# journal/ — Markdown Journal Templates

**Owner:** Basanta (P3)  
**Source data:** `GET http://LAPTOP:8000/journal` (auto-generated by backend)

## What lives here

| File | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `template.md` | Handlebars-style template showing the journal format |

## Journal format

```markdown
# Buddy journal — 12 Sep 2026

## Goals
- Email professor
- Senior design until 10 PM

## Incidents
- 21:14 — League of Legends during senior-design block (score 12, 54s).

## Day score: 68/100

## Suggestion
Email first tomorrow before opening anything else.
```

## How the backend generates it

`GET /journal` on `backend/main.py` queries tasks + incidents from the DB and renders this markdown. No template engine needed — plain string joins.

## Notability integration (demo move)

1. Open `http://LAPTOP:8000/journal` in a browser
2. Select all → Copy
3. Paste into Notability as a new note titled "Buddy — 12 Sep 2026"

Or show the rendered markdown on the Lovable dashboard (`dashboard/index.html`) and describe it as the live journal export.
